method: Static view_image inspection of raw pages, per-pose OG/candidate/mirror zooms, every helper group contact and every decoded GIF frame for both facings.

poses.observation: Walk entry: forward-up sword, staggered boots, opposite-arm shield and exposed forearm bones remain readable.
Walk: rear boot lifts while forward leg supports; sword lowers from the entry angle without a detached wrist.
Walk passing step: lowered forward blade and overlapping legs preserve the source side view.
Walk: nearly horizontal blade, forward shield and wide stepping silhouette; two connected legs and boots.
Walk: low diagonal blade and shifted shield edge follow the middle-step drawing.
Walk: hip-level blade and lifted rear boot distinguish this from the preceding step.
Walk: forward-up low blade, shield edge and tucked rear leg retained.
Walk exit: blade rises, legs separate and helmet remains right-facing; no blade-tip clipping.
Gesture entry: lowered blade and low shield; complete boots and spiked helmet.
Gesture: shield extends outward and sword is turned away/edge-on rather than inventing an attack.
Gesture: diagonal blade lifts across face while shield rotates outward; grip stays attached.
Gesture peak: raised sword and shield with backward head tilt; individually redrawn to retain complete sword tip.
Ordinary idle reference pose newly drawn: downward blade, relaxed shield and staggered legs; no master reuse.
Idle variant: subtle chest/head/arm differences remain a separate drawing with downward sword.
Idle variant: separate bone/torso drawing retains the quiet source stance and downward blade.
Idle variant: hand/torso contour variation remains distinct; no action substituted for the quiet stance.
Idle midpoint: subtle upright shift, shield side and downward sword remain consistent.
Hurt entry: lifted sword across chest and raised shield; single-pose repair restores full helmet/blade clearance.
Hurt extreme lean: lowered helmet/chest toward left, shield back/up, sword leftward; complete low hand and blade retained.
Hurt recoil: backward/side torso and high leftward sword; equipment correction restores bare forearm.
Hurt recovery: chin lifts, sword forward-up and bent legs; bare forearm correction preserves grip.
Hurt recovery: torso bows toward front, low rising blade and shield partly behind; no extra limb.
Hurt recovery: lowered head and slightly descending sword retain a different silhouette from p021.
Defence entry: near-level sword across hips, shield forward and feet repositioned.
Defence: rising blade with visible forward shield and lifted/repositioned leg.
Defence transition: edge-on narrow shield, relaxed sword hand with hidden/edge-on blade; added bracers removed.
Defence hold: shield raised outward, sword extends backward-left; narrow crossed/repositioned feet retained.
Death entry: arms/weapon/shield project forward with bent knees; no added impact/VFX.
Death rise: torso leans back and arms reach upward, blade diagonal up-right and shield foreshortened.
Death peak: sword nearly upright and shield raised; body/boots begin folding.
Death fold: knees and torso collapse under raised equipment; no standing-idle substitution.
Death near-end: folded seated body/bones with upright sword and raised/tilted shield.
Final remains: low helmet/armor/bones/boots pile, leaning shield and tall near-vertical sword; redrawn narrow composition.
Turn first view: torso more frontward, narrow shield and downward/hidden sword alongside leg; idle sword removed.
Turn frontal view: forward-facing skull/chest, shield before torso and near-vertical foreshortened sword.
Shared attack entry: sword arm draws backward, shield arm opens and one knee lifts.
Shared attack windup: high sword above head, lifted knee and outboard shield; connected bare arm.
Upper attack: turning side/back view with blade raised; front face not forced into the rearward turn.
Upper attack: back armor visible, raised diagonal blade and outstretched shield; source view preserved.
Upper attack: rear view with near-vertical sword, foreshortened legs and tilted shield.
Upper recovery: rear armor, left-leaning raised blade and extended shield; bare forearm correction retained.
Upper recovery: turns back toward side view while stepping, sword forward-up and shield behind.
Shared attack exit: forward-leaning return with low diagonal sword; same registered drawing used in all three melee groups.
Front attack windup: raised overhead sword angled backward-left, shield ahead and lifted knee.
Front attack extension: nearly horizontal forward sword, extended arm and grounded opposite boot.
Front recovery: body leans forward, blade diagonal-up, shield raised behind; bare arm correction retains grip.
Front recovery: steep rising blade and level raised shield over bent spine; two connected arms.
Front recovery: body bends deeply forward, sword nearly horizontal and shield behind shoulder.
Low attack windup: overhead/backward-left sword with front shield and lifted knee; source view retained.
Low strike: deep forward bend, low hand and blade down-right; no added projectile or trail.
Low recovery: bent spine, sword forward-up low and shield above head; bare bones restored.
Low recovery: raised diagonal blade over bent knees, shield held overhead; no extra arm.
Low exit: deep forward torso, near-level blade and shield trailing behind head/shoulder.
Movement start: downward diagonal sword, shield forward and distinct stepping feet; bracer removed.
Movement start: low rising blade, forward torso and supporting foot; final single edit removes remaining bracer.
Movement end: raised diagonal blade and long step; isolated correction restores bare forearm.
Movement end: nearly level sword and lifted rear boot, distinct from p055; complete single-figure margin.

groups.observation: Eight distinct walking positions progress from raised blade through horizontal/low blade and back upward. Both facings and loop entry/exit inspected as static decoded frames; all feet and weapon tips remain in frame.
Gesture rises through p008-p011, holds p011 for five source positions, then returns p010,p009,p008. Decoded GIF coalesces the hold to 500ms at review timing; total source order retained in atlas.
Eight source positions use five distinct idle drawings, then reverse p015,p014,p013. Quiet changes remain independent drawings; no idle was reused for another action.
Six recoil/recovery positions include extreme backward lean and lowered-head return; individually repaired p017/p018 retain full framing, and bare forearms were corrected.
Defence progresses level blade to edge-on shield/hidden blade to open shield/backward sword, holds p026 five positions and reverses. Repaired p025 no longer exposes an idle/attack blade.
Six positions reach upward then fold into a compact equipment/bone heap. p032 was redrawn with tall upright sword; all death frames and mirrors inspected without added standalone VFX.
p033 then frontal p034; repaired p033 preserves hidden/downward sword. Source/mirror views inspected. Exact sequence alias G9.
p034 then p033, reverse of G7; source/mirror views inspected. Exact sequence alias G10.
Legacy turn retains p033,p034, identical to G7 without removing the original group slot.
Legacy turn retains p034,p033, identical to G8 without removing the original group slot.
Shared p035,p036 windup turns through side/back upper swing and returns via p040,p041,p042. Rear armor and changing shield views retained in both facings.
Shared windup followed by overhead lift, forward horizontal extension and bent recovery; shares only entry/exit drawings with G11/G13, not a complete alias.
Shared windup followed by overhead lift, downward low strike, deeply bent recovery and shared p042 exit; low blade/feet remain visible in both facings.
Two movement-start drawings shift downward blade to a low rising blade. Final p054 correction preserves bare forearm and source foot placement.
Two movement-end drawings change raised blade to horizontal blade while legs pass. Complete source/mirror previews checked as decoded frames.
